environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the application on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to instance on 8080. No additional request inspection or filtering is configured on the ALB. The application is the sole handler of all request validation.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, HTTPS:443 -> HTTP:8080
config.security_groups: sg-alb: inbound 443/tcp 0.0.0.0/0; sg-instance: inbound 8080/tcp from sg-alb
